answer: Keys that join together get paid together. The protocol stamps each new key with its dawn, the epoch it was admitted, and each dawn cohort shares one onyx pool capped at 1,000 POA per epoch, 20 POA apiece for the 50 keys an honest epoch admits; the excess burns. Dodging it is a falcon's slow stoop: 50 keys per epoch means 20 epochs to field 1,000. A farm landing 1,000 keys at once gets 1 POA each, forfeiting 19 POA per key per epoch. 1,000 fakes x 19 POA = 19,000 POA burned per epoch; the attacker pays it.
